Porcelain Veneers Improve The Esthetics Of Your Smile

At Clearwater Dentist, we specialize in porcelain veneers as an aesthetic dental solution, tailored specifically to help create the smile you have always dreamed of by concealing any cosmetic flaws on the surface of your teeth with a natural appearance. These ultra-thin porcelain shells can cover any unattractive or cosmetically imperfect tooth shapes; unlike dental crowns which typically serve to protect and restore damaged teeth, veneers focus solely on improving aesthetics of smile for cosmetic concerns.

 

Porcelain veneers are increasingly sought-after treatments due to their ability to transform dull, worn teeth and stains into an inviting smile that closely resembles natural ones. By quickly covering minor imperfections on tooth surfaces, veneers offer an effective alternative to long treatments for cosmetic changes. It is important to keep in mind that prior to initiating porcelain veneer treatment a healthy mouth must exist free of gum disease or other conditions.

 

The process typically entails two appointments. On your initial visit, we use digital intraoral cameras to capture images of your teeth and design new porcelain veneers based on your desired smile goals. You will have an opportunity to provide input and suggest adjustments until your satisfaction has been achieved. At subsequent tooth preparation appointments, we carefully adjust the length, width, color, and shape of veneers until they fit perfectly and create your dream smile.

 

At your second appointment, a small amount of enamel will be removed from your front teeth in order to ensure proper fit for veneers and bonding them onto them. With proper care, these veneers should last years longer - giving you a beautiful natural smile with lasting confidence!

What Is a Porcelain Veneer?

Porcelain veneers are ultra-thin shells designed to cover the facial surfaces of teeth in order to address dental problems such as:

 

●    Worn tooth enamel

●    Uneven tooth alignment or spacing

●    Tooth discoloration

●    Chips or cracks


Get in touch with us today to find out whether you are a candidate for porcelain veneers.

Benefits of Porcelain Veneers

Veneers are widely associated with cosmetic dentistry for their ability to transform smiles by aligning and shaping teeth beautifully, yet they provide more than aesthetic benefits. Veneers also possess protective properties, potentially eliminating more extensive dental treatments altogether. Furthermore, veneers offer durability, improved smile aesthetics, minimal tooth structure removal and require less preparation compared to crowns.

Dental Crowns

Crowns are typically constructed of ceramic or porcelain material and carefully designed to closely resemble natural tooth enamel, seamlessly blending in your smile. Their exterior replicates this appearance while their interior can be adjusted slightly with minor adjustments for proper positioning over your existing tooth. Crowns serve two important purposes - protecting natural teeth by providing biting and chewing functionality restoration as well as aesthetically providing the appearance of health.

Dental Bridges

Missing teeth create an unsightly gap in your smile, leaving an unsightly gap that needs to be filled by something. Left untreated, this gap can cause various complications such as neighboring tooth shift, altered bite, jaw bone degeneration and eating issues. Dental bridges offer an effective solution: these multi-dental crown structures bridge over gaps created by missing teeth to restore both function and appearance of real teeth for seamless smiles with proper oral function.
